title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next AD-IQ4_XS — AtomicChat on an M5 Max 64GB Mac
slug_note: An 85GB build that exceeds 64GB of RAM by keeping a 39GB n-gram PLE table pageable, at 36 tok/s with vision.

variation.quant_detail: AD-3.84bpw-IQ4_XS-M64: a 45.8GB file plus a 39.1GB pageable n-gram PLE table (84.9GB total)

engine.config: llama.cpp on Apple Silicon (Metal), with the n-gram PLE table left pageable so the build exceeds physical RAM.

requirements.notes: Vendor reports 44,125 MiB model-self (MTL0) with a 57,344 MiB wired limit, plus ~37,279 MiB host for the pageable PLE table — i.e. the file set is larger than 64GB by design and pages from disk.

offload.locator: card lines 47, 91-92, 120-123 (39 GB table never enters memory; stays on SSD; mmap on; goes to the host by itself)
offload.note: Vendor-intentional design: shard 2 holds nothing but the table so Metal never wires it (card lines 70-76). cold_start_effect is absent: first-token latency under paging was not measured. No unconditional-fit wording is attached to this record.

memory_profile.locator: card lines 80-84 (build table) + memory breakdown lines 50-52
memory_profile.note: 84.9 GB file set on a 64 GB box by design: 45.8 GB weights resident, 39.1 GB table on SSD.

entries.locator: card line 82: on-SSD 39.1 GB; lines 91-92: excluded from in-memory because it stays on SSD
entries.note: 51.2B-parameter n-gram lookup table; ~3 MB/s of random reads at 36 tok/s (card lines 57-64).

steps.text: Download the AD-3.84bpw-IQ4_XS-M64 build and its n-gram PLE table
Serve with llama.cpp on Metal, keeping the PLE table pageable
Add the mmproj file if vision is needed

repo_revision.locator: the HF card, not a repo, is the recipe (dossier section 9)

measurements.context: tg128, with vision, on the 85GB AD build that exceeds machine RAM via the pageable PLE table

conditions.context_label: tg128 decode with vision, vendor table

measurements.context: MTL0 model-self 44,125 MiB (wired limit 57,344 MiB); host adds 37,279 MiB for the pageable table

caveats: Vendor-run and vendor-published; not independently reproduced.
The 85GB file set exceeds 64GB of RAM — it works only because the PLE table is pageable. Expect disk-bound first-token latency.

sources.note: the AD build and its measured speed/memory table
sources.locator: memory-shape section lines 41-76; quants table lines 80-99; run lines 101-125; traps + quality context lines 127-190

capability_observations.note: Vision needs the separate mmproj projector file; the 36 tok/s headline is with vision. The card's quants cover the text path (card line 241).

checks.note: Measured against one reference (BF16 PPL 4.0445 +/- 0.0216), one corpus, one machine (card lines 94-96). Vendor-measured; not independently reproduced.
The card's own pick is AD-4.27bpw (KLD 0.0842, top-1 89.49%, line 83-86); the 3.84bpw recipe ships below it and its measured cost is the top-1 drop, not hidden.

correctness.note: The speed rows have no output-quality gate; quality evidence lives only in the card's table, recorded separately here.

lineages.locator: memory-shape, quants, run, traps, and quality sections
lineages.note: Single-vendor lineage; the card is the only source and it re-quantizes routinely.

claims.statement: The 39.1 GB n-gram lookup table pages from SSD via mmap (kept in its own shard so Metal never wires it); at 36 tok/s that is ~3 MB/s of random reads against a 28 ms per-token budget, which is why ordinary offloading's failure mode does not apply.
claims.quote: It works because 39 GB of that file never enters memory at all.

claims.statement: The 84.9 GB build runs on the 64 GB box ONLY because the PLE table pages from disk (44,125 MiB model-self vs 57,344 MiB wired limit plus 37,279 MiB host); this is not a general fits verdict and an 85 GB build on 64 GB hardware cannot be one.
AD-3.84bpw quality row: mean KLD 0.2277, same top-1 82.68%, PPL ratio 1.102; the card's pick AD-4.27bpw reads 0.0842 / 89.49% / 1.026.

open_questions.question: Whether the pageable table ever crossed a memory-pressure ceiling is not recorded by the vendor card; that limit is absent from the source rather than whitewashed.
No pin exists for the card; the vendor re-quantizes and re-measures routinely.
